description: Shoppes at Homestead is a premier community shopping center strategically located in the heart of Silicon Valley's Sunnyvale, positioned near the Apple campus and surrounded by one of the nation's most affluent residential areas. This 116,109 square foot center has established itself as a neighborhood destination, offering a carefully curated mix of essential services, fitness, dining, and retail options that cater to the sophisticated needs of the local tech community. Anchored by key retailers including CRUNCH FITNESS, CVS Pharmacy, and Orchard Supply Hardware, the center provides a comprehensive shopping experience that balances everyday convenience with quality lifestyle amenities. The property benefits from exceptional demographics, serving a trade area where average household incomes exceed $290,000 and home values average nearly $1.9 million, making it one of the most desirable retail locations in the San Jose-Sunnyvale-Santa Clara market. With its array of casual global eateries and diverse tenant mix, Shoppes at Homestead attracts over 2.4 million visits annually, cementing its position as an integral part of the community's daily life and a thriving retail destination in one of America's most dynamic markets.
